answered.sql: SELECT T.name, T.description FROM Treatments T WHERE T.treatment_id IN (SELECT S.treatment_id FROM Spa_Treatments S GROUP BY S.treatment_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT S.spa_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Spa))
